## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (98%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class set [F1], 0% invasive risk, model agreement, and high reliability support tier-4 review.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 98%, InSitu 1%, Normal 0%, Invasive 0% | Clear separation; 0% risk |
| Conformal set | Benign (90% target/coverage, n=132) | Single-class dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 64th-percentile OOD, 12/12 regions [F6] | Typical quality; unflagged |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent models concur |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Benign, 2/5 Normal (88%–92%) [F5] | Neighbors Benign/Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 4, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (-0.63) [F2]; 18/20 spot-check, caption inconsistent · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 7) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical (-0.56) [F3], 0/20 AI spot-check · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical (-0.45) [F4]; weak, 0/20 spot-check · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 5) · context · Mildly elevated (+0.23); 8/20 AI spot-check · Weak
- **Dead cell fraction** (regions 3, 8, 11) · context · 2% (93rd percentile) [F7], 2 cells; wrong-direction · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful (top-3 deletion drop +0.0114 vs random, CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unverified (deletion +0.0008, CI -0.0088–0.0064); relies on unreliable normal lobules, mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Focal atypia or invasion is in region 5 (duct-confined 1.02) or 8 (risk 0.005).
- Tissue is normal parenchyma, matching 2/5 neighbors (contrast BACH_0262, 88% similarity).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 4, 9**: Confirm benign tubule architecture driving the strongest anti-invasive score.
2. **Region 8**: Inspect the only nonzero risk (0.005) and highest invasion score (0.70).
3. **Regions 3, 5**: Check duct-confined cells and TILs in 5; verify 2 dead cells in 3.
